routes.approach: Take the Neffs Canyon trail until it levels and turns from road to trail. Cross the creek at the fork and follow the old pipeline road along the west fork. The trail leaves the creek and winds through trees; stay in the basin the creek has cut and you reach a waterfall, which you bypass on the east side (climber's left) to enter the couloir. routes.name: Reese Couloir
routes.approach: Park at the end of Gilead Way. The old trail by the water tower is hard to reach without crossing private property, so the approach is a bushwhack to a creek crossing, then a game trail with a steep, often wet step and an easily missed fork to the right.
